candidates.title: Akudama Drive
candidates.reason: A completed 12-episode cyberpunk crime/action thriller with sustained pursuit by state Executioners, a dangerous train heist, concealed motives, betrayals, escalating revelations about Kansai and Kanto, and an ordinary protagonist forced to survive by deception. Whole-series criticism documents frequent high-intensity action, graphic violence, irreversible deaths, fast pacing, striking neon visual direction, and the grim authoritarian setting. Its strongest fit is dark sci-fi mystery, cat-and-mouse tension, brutality and spectacle, not a supernatural battle anime. Important weaknesses: no magical/supernatural system, very little structured power progression or training, and comparatively less sustained intellectual dueling than a pure psychological mystery. The cast's specialized skills and technology should not be mistaken for a deep codified power system. The reviews also flag uneven character depth, rushed development and disturbing sexual-threat content. DNA values describe the released 12-episode series, not a trailer or single episode.
